title: Report labelled feed-integrity findings for damaged imported consumption
outcome: Doctor and projection verification report the specific invalid imported-consumption feed entry while retaining other findings, with true SQLite failures still propagated.
acceptance: A damaged or misprojected imported-consumption record produces a labelled feed-integrity finding naming the bad entry and does not discard unrelated findings.
Meaningful behavioral coverage distinguishes malformed canonical/projection data from actual SQLite failure without silently swallowing storage errors.
